plan.title: bug(design-critique): bare-arc spend recommend-first still asks (need spend-resolve verb + ask-deny)

narratives.Description: Prevention follow-up: bare-arc spend recommend-first still opens a spend ask before recording spend-recommend. Prefer-A Bound 6047799269.
narratives.Overview:
## Bound remedy (#5466 Prefer-A 6047799269)

1. Recut Spend ask-MUST: bare arc missing recommend is parent defect (record then resolve).
2. Add design-critique:spend-resolve with required --recommend.
3. State-keyed PreToolUse deny for ask tools until spend-recommend recorded.
4. Skill Stop 1 calls spend-resolve first.
5. Root-cause probe note for #5465 class in CHANGELOG.
6. Leave parseOperatorSpend/evaluateSpendRecord intact except limb-1 recut.

conflict_group: bare-arc-spend-recommend-first-runtime

items.title: Recut Spend ask-MUST for bare-arc missing recommend

narrative.Acceptance: Recut content/contracts/design-critique.md Spend (#4705) so bare arc (no closed n=/panel) with missing spend-recommend: is a parent defect: record spend-recommend then resolve spend:/spend-ask:resolved. Ask only for ambiguous mixes, bare panel, or parent-declared unclosable recommend. Update skill Spend one-liner via pack source + packs:render. Pin recut sentences in design_critique_contract.test.ts and add spend.test.ts parent-defect fixture. Not silence to N=1.

Add deft design-critique:spend-resolve -- --utterance <text> --recommend N=1|N>=3. Records closed spend-recommend: plus resolved spend:/spend-ask: via parseOperatorSpend/evaluateSpendRecord. Without --recommend on bare arc: refuse non-zero with remediation; never ask; never default N=1. Mirror only resolveArcRunPostureForHost front-door pattern; do not copy posture missing-token auto-resolve. Wire route-argv + dispatch + content/commands.md.

items.title: State-keyed PreToolUse deny for spend asks before recommend

narrative.Acceptance: Add host PreToolUse deny for structured ask tools matching QUESTION_HOOK_MATCHER while a design-critique arc is in flight and no closed spend-recommend: exists yet in parent-written arc state readable by the Grok hook. Remediation names spend-resolve. Keep #5373 hatch. Drop utterance-keyed spend-shaped classifier.
Update deft-directive-design-critique Stop 1 to call spend-resolve before any operator surface; skill forbid is discoverability into limbs 1-3, not sole prevention.

Before claiming the stack closed the #5465 class, record a root-cause probe note in acceptance/CHANGELOG: whether that Grok parent carried host-memory always-ask (evaluateHostMemorySpendConflict) or skipped skill load. Does not replace limbs 1-3.
Leave parseOperatorSpend / evaluateSpendRecord closed-token semantics and #5372 Prefer-A recommend-first rule intact except for the limb-1 ask-MUST recut.

`N≥3` remains a recorded parent panel-permission claim the verb accepts, not something the parser invents.

Keep #5373 hard-stop hatch for real ambiguity after a resolve attempt.

Update `deft-directive-design-critique` Stop 1 to call spend-resolve before any operator surface; present the skill ⊗ as discoverability into limbs 1–3, not as sole prevention.

Leave `parseOperatorSpend` / `evaluateSpendRecord` closed-token semantics and #5372 Prefer-A recommend-first rule intact except for the limb-1 ask-MUST recut.
